name: DIGITAL BOYMEAT
source:
Your boyfriend has invented a new genre of snuff: consensual torture for the extreme masochist! You have no choice but to make sure he doesn't accidentally kill someone… Which means taking an active part in this stupid endeavour. 

[Edited from [url=https://johannofart.itch.io/digital-boymeat]itch.io[/url]]
